project.name: mio-cua
project.tagline: Give your AI eyes, not APIs — a computer-use agent that sees your Windows screen and operates any app like a human.
project.description: AI desktop automation agent for Windows: scene-graph perception (OCR + UIA), pure-vision web automation, MCP server. Works with cheap models.
features: Scene Graph perception: OCR + UIA fused into a graph with verified action candidates
Web without DOM: pure-vision control via Regions + OmniParser, no extension
Cross-app workflows: one natural-language task spanning multiple apps
MCP server included: 27 tools for Claude / Cursor / ChatGPT
Safe by design: F9 emergency stop, audit trail, dry-run, virtual-desktop isolation
competitors: Traditional RPA (UiPath): drag-drop flows that break when the UI changes
Accessibility-only agents: depend on apps exposing UIA, break on custom-rendered UIs
Coordinate-guessing agents: no way to notice a missed click
